name: help
description: Built-in documentation system for Crystal Ball MCP tools. Call with no arguments to see the full tool index organized by category. Pass a tool name for its man page, a topic name for a conceptual guide, or an examples category for a cookbook of worked examples.

parameters.tool: string (optional) — Tool name to get its man page, e.g. "correlate", "query_raw"
parameters.topic: string (optional) — Conceptual topic: getting-started, watchlists, alerts, correlation, sentinel
parameters.examples: string (optional) — Example cookbook: cross-domain, time-series, watchlists, alert-rules

examples.description: Get the man page for the correlate tool
